recipes.name: The Easiest Garlic Cabbage Side Dish (3 Ingredients)
ingredients: 3 cups green cabbage, quartered, cored and thinly sliced
instructions: In a large saute pan set over high heat, add the garlic oil. Once hot, add the sliced cabbage. Toss to coat and char cabbage until brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Season with salt, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Taste and add more garlic oil if desired.
To serve, use a carving fork and twist the cabbage as you would pasta and plate.
